FX Senshi Kurumi-chan Anime Overview:

Kurumi Fukuga is a university student who enters the high-stakes realm of foreign exchange trading to recover a massive financial debt left behind by her mother. Armed with optimism and an initial desire for quick financial recovery, she quickly learns how volatile and ruthless the global currency markets can be. As market fluctuations trigger rapid gains and devastating losses, Kurumi navigates the stressful environment alongside a circle of fellow traders who share her dangerous obsession with speculation. Together, the group confronts the psychological pressure and financial risks of the trade while attempting to survive the unpredictable swings of the economy.

Japanese Title: FX戦士くるみちゃん

Official Site: https://fxkurumi-info.com/
